ruling: docs/C4-DECISION-SHEET-2026-08-02.md calls 3, 4, 5, 7 — Captain-ratified 'all defaults' 2026-08-02. Per-shape axes are ratified freely per the same ruling ('no value lost to build per shape axis').

rule:aura-taps-enchanted-permanent.definition: An Aura taps the permanent it enchants, by its own triggered or activated ability. The attachment already fixed the object, so nothing is targeted (grammar §6a; CR 601.2c).

rule:aura-destroys-enchanted-land.definition: An Aura destroys the land it enchants. No targeting: the attachment fixed the object (grammar §6a).

rule:aura-untaps-enchanted-land.definition: An Aura untaps the land it enchants, as an upkeep or activated benefit. No targeting (grammar §6a).

rule:prevent-fixed-damage-from-chosen-so.definition: Prevents the next fixed amount of damage from a SOURCE OF YOUR CHOICE. Choosing is not targeting: the choice cannot be responded to by changing targets and is unaffected by ward or hexproof (grammar §6a).

rule:prevents-damage-to-controller.definition: A static or replacement effect prevents damage that would be dealt to the permanent's CONTROLLER — the player, not the permanent. Distinct from rule:prevents-damage-to-self, which protects the permanent itself (grammar §6a: 'you' and 'this permanent' are different objects).

rule:grants-double-strike-chosen-own-cre.definition: Gives double strike until end of turn to A CREATURE YOU CONTROL, chosen rather than targeted. Two printed distinctions from rule:grants-double-strike-target: the creature is chosen, not targeted, and it is ownership-restricted (grammar §6a).

rule:copy-own-creature-token.definition: Creates a token copy of a creature YOU CONTROL. Ownership-restricted sibling of rule:copy-creature-token, which can copy any creature (grammar §6a).

rule:attack-trigger-pump-own-creature.definition: An attack-triggered ability gives a creature ITS CONTROLLER CONTROLS a temporary power/toughness boost. Ownership-restricted sibling of rule:attack-trigger-pump-any-creature.

rule:etb-pump-own-creature.definition: When the permanent enters, a triggered ability gives a creature ITS CONTROLLER CONTROLS a temporary power/toughness boost. Ownership-restricted sibling of rule:etb-pump-target-creature. Reverses batch-6 D3's facet treatment per grammar §6a.

rule:sets-base-power-or-toughness-own-cr.definition: Sets the base power and/or toughness of creatures ITS CONTROLLER CONTROLS. Ownership-restricted sibling of rule:sets-base-power-or-toughness.

rule:attack-trigger-untap-own-attacker.definition: An attack trigger untaps an attacking creature ITS CONTROLLER CONTROLS. Ownership-restricted sibling of rule:attack-trigger-untap-attacker.

rule:activated-untap-another-own-permane.definition: An activated ability untaps another target permanent ITS CONTROLLER CONTROLS. Ownership-restricted sibling of rule:activated-untap-another-permanent.

rule:mass-damage-opponents.definition: Deals damage to EACH OPPONENT, without targeting. 'Each opponent' and 'each player' are different claims with different in-game consequences and never share an axis (grammar §6a). Distinct from rule:mass-damage-opponent-creatures-only, which hits creatures.

call 4 — Urza's Armor prevents damage dealt to YOU, the player
call 4 — 'a creature you control' is chosen, not targeted, and is ownership-restricted

call 5 — your 3a ruling: any must mean any
call 5 — Herald of the Fair is 'target creature you control'; reverses batch-6 D3

call 5 — Kelpie Guide: 'another target permanent you control'

rule:etb-grants-connive-to-other-creatur.definition: When the permanent enters, a triggered ability makes a creature its controller controls connive. Printed text says 'target creature you control', not 'another' (grammar §6a).
rule:etb-grants-connive-to-other-creatur.why: call 7 — Mob Lookout prints no 'other'; both members are ownership-restricted
